scope: R4 only: pinned launchers without windows and .desktop Actions from the original KDE task menu

design.pinnedLaunchers: BwmLaunchRouter: QIdentityProxyModel + exported TaskManager::AbstractTasksProxyModelIface inserted by the bridge between KDE TaskFilterProxyModel and ConcatenateTasksProxyModel (virtual QAbstractProxyModel::setSourceModel). requestActivate/requestNewInstance/requestOpenUrls on LauncherTasksModel rows queue {action:launcher,launcherUrl,urls}; all other rows/requests pass through. KDE concatenation and LauncherTasksModel untouched (manual sorting maps through it).
design.serviceActions: TaskMenuPolicy identifies the QActions that the original Backend parented to the reviewed ContextMenu.qml (SHA256 unchanged) and matches the trailing ones against the .desktop Actions (same filtering as Backend::jumpListActions; separator/icon/text with mnemonics removed and elision). Routed actions queue {action:service-action,launcherUrl,serviceAction}; KDE handler stays connected. Places/Recent Files actions (built from the disposable host data) are masked (disabled), not routed.
design.hostPolicy: Disposable host XDG_CONFIG_DIRS gets an immutable KDE KIOSK kdeglobals [KDE Action Restrictions][$i] run_desktop_files=false, shell_access=false (written O_EXCL by native_launch.write_host_policy in preview-isolated.py and check-local.py). KIO ApplicationLauncherJob/OpenUrlJob in the host are denied before spawning; preview startup requires applicationLauncher.inProcessLaunchDenied=true.
design.helper: native-tasks.py launch_launcher (no window identity; Breeze rechecked under the shared native lock) -> bwm-plasma-host --launch-task-application with restored caller XDG/D-Bus/Qt environment -> KIO::ApplicationLauncherJob(KService) or (KServiceAction). Launcher resolution mirrors runApp (applications:, preferred:, local .desktop) without its OpenUrlJob/executable fallback; other schemes rejected.

localTests.ctestAsan: 13/13 with ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1 (includes native-task-thumbnail and native-task-delegate-render under ASan)
localTests.panelTasksQtTest: PanelTaskTest 4/4 incl. init/cleanup: window rows still route to BwmTaskSource through the router; pinned launcher activate/new-instance/open-urls queue 3 launcher requests and empty drop none; original ContextMenu.qml routes 2 Actions ("Compose & send" with & and mnemonics), hides NoDisplay, masks Places (FileManager); KDE hides Open New Window for pure launchers (LauncherTasksModel CanLaunchNewInstance=false); no in-process launch marker after triggering; manual launcher move/syncLaunchers preserved.

sessionSmoke.origin: executed by the assistant in the user Hyprland session (IPC accessible in this run), no clicks, no applications launched
sessionSmoke.stop: panel-session.py stop acknowledged; no host process, registry inactive, no leftover layers; skin still plasma

previousAuxiliaryAtStart: not running (no process, panel-session status active=false); Breeze active
notVerified: preferred://mailer command fallback and runApp non-application URLs (rejected by design)

userAcceptance.origin: manual test by the user in the Hyprland session, auxiliary launched by the assistant on request
userAcceptance.newWindowAppendedRight: expected KDE behaviour for org.kde.plasma.taskmanager (separateLaunchers default true; launchInPlace requires iconsOnly + manual sort)
